A1_parser_drops_X_quantity.detail: additional_cost=Required(EffectCost(Bounce)); Bounce target=Typed/Subtype Swamp, controller You, selection at_resolution; zero quantity-like fields in the cost subtree; oracle_text requires 'return X Swamps you control'. X is bound only in the damage effect (Ref(Variable X)), never in the cost.

A2_coverage_parse_detail_hardcoded_suppo.detail: coverage.rs:6108 build_additional_cost_items: AdditionalCost::Required(_) -> label 'AdditionalCost:Required' with supported:true hardcoded (line 6150); additional_cost_has_unimplemented only recurses Unimplemented leaves, so EffectCost(Bounce) takes the supported:true path.

A3_coverage_gap_audit_misses_effect_cost.detail: collect_ability_cost_missing_parts (8923) flags EffectCost only when the inner effect is Effect::Unimplemented; Effect::Bounce is a recognized variant -> no gap. StructuralFeature::AdditionalCost (9310 emit site) is classified Handled blanket (9496) regardless of inner shape. Combined with A2, the row must be supported:true, gap_count:0.

A4_runtime_cannot_resolve_bounce_as_cost.detail: costs.rs:1545 effect-as-cost interpreter implements only Mana / SetTapState(tap granter) / counters arms; every other shape, including Effect::Bounce, falls through to payment_failed('Effect-as-cost not yet resolvable'). Confirms the issue's claim that Bounce is not an implemented effect-cost shape.
